acceptance_requires: receipt binding to exact candidate source and asset version

criteria.evidence: No premature no-result state across observed pending requests.
All seven bounded client queries returned source-linked rows with required classification or buyer evidence.
Pension and Central Bank cases displayed exact source entity types; no generic Entities label passed.
RFP and manager-search cases displayed exact source RFP or Opportunity classifications.
Sovereign Wealth Fund context survived data and visualization paths with no cross-type or defunct rows.
The two-character probe emitted zero API requests; the three-character probe emitted real requests.
Initial Smart Search remained uncluttered and the detailed screen exposed category refinement plus source-derived filters.
All Results defaulted to five rows per represented category.
Detailed transaction results defaulted to exactly ten visible rows.
Default source request omitted include_defunct and observed zero defunct rows.

Entities, Transactions, RFPs/Opportunities, News, and People displayed only filter options observed in current SWFI responses. Entities, Transactions, and RFPs/Opportunities passed simultaneous two-filter checks; News and People passed every applicable disclosed dimension, with zero source-value mismatches.
Post-deploy allocator API checks returned count 901 in 1.636 seconds for 30 days and count 2396 in 3.296 seconds for 90 days.
criteria.bad_news: No client-approved latency SLA was supplied, so this proves measured improvement and correctness, not SLA compliance.

criteria.blocker: The complete client-query spreadsheet, two presentations, and email attachment were not found; no examples were invented.
SWFI committed to reshare the category-specific filter list. Period semantics and approved CALA/Southeast Asia country membership remain undefined.
The meeting explicitly deferred comprehensive free-form language; the external corpus and approved model contract are missing.

remaining_risk: The frontend and canonical backend worktrees contain pre-existing WIP and remain unstaged; the deployed backend patch is still isolated from the canonical backend Git worktree.
The 20260718T132622Z release source directory was modified through a superseded symlink alias; rollback must use the recorded prior image IDs rather than rebuilding that directory.
The complete client query corpus and filter specification are still external blockers.
No approved latency SLA exists, so measured response times cannot be labeled SLA-compliant.
A daily source-refresh schedule and freshness receipt were not proved by this acceptance run.
